Author: EvolveXIV
Name: Party Icons Evolved
Punchline: Highly customizable job icons and raid role indicators on party nameplates.
Description:
Customises the nameplates above your party members using the game's own nameplate UI.

- Show or hide the name, shorten it to a maximum length (on top of the game's own Display Name Settings) and recolour it.
- Add a job icon with configurable style, position and size.
- Add a raid role indicator (MT, OT, H1, H2, M1, M2, R1, R2) with configurable colours.
- Roles are assigned automatically, by a party chat message that contains only the role (e.g. "M1"), or from the right-click menu.

Open the settings with /pie.
